ontology.title: The shape of the product
ontology.neverSynced: Not synced yet — the map is empty until the first sync.
ontology.notConfigured: Connect Pendo first — the product map is built from your features, pages, and segments. Add an Integration API key in Administration, then come back and sync.

setup.lede: Free-form instructions the agent follows on every turn in this workspace. Pricing, North Star metrics, naming conventions, internal accounts to ignore, response style — anything you'd otherwise have to repeat in chat.
setup.fieldHelp: Plain English. Bullets, paragraphs, or a mix — whatever's easiest to read. The agent re-reads this on every request; edits take effect immediately.
setup.placeholder:
Examples:

- We charge $20/seat/month for Pro, $60/seat/month for Enterprise.
- North Star is weekly active accounts (WAA).
- Ignore visitors with qa@ or @test.acme.com in their email.
- Default to numEvents for engagement; only use numMinutes if explicitly asked.
- Lead with the headline number, then ≤2 supporting cuts.
setup.footBody: These instructions are appended to every system prompt the agent receives in this workspace, in the uncached layer — so edits take effect on the next chat turn without delay. Nothing here is shared across workspaces.

skills.label: Custom skills
skills.help: Workspace-specific playbooks the agent can follow. Each skill has a name, a description of when to trigger it, and a body — usually a system-prompt-style instruction set. Enable the ones you want the agent to consider on every turn.
skills.exampleA: Onboarding maturity matrix — your team's phase model and exit criteria, so the agent can generate a per-customer maturity notebook.
skills.exampleB: QBR template — the exact set of cells, queries, and narrative cuts your QBR notebooks always include.
skills.exampleC: Churn risk audit — the symptoms, queries, and red-flag thresholds you check when a CSM flags an account.
skills.triggersPh: When should the agent use this skill?
skills.triggersHelp: Plain-English description of the kinds of requests this skill handles. The agent matches user messages against this.
skills.bodyPh: The skill's content — usually a system prompt that tells the agent how to structure the notebook, which queries to run, and what to say.
skills.empty: No custom skills yet. Add one to give the agent a workspace-specific playbook.
skills.maxReached: Maximum of {max} skills reached. Remove one to add another.
skills.fixInstructionsFirst: Resolve the instructions character limit before updating a skill.

masthead.lede: Wire up model providers, the Pendo integration key, the MCP servers your agent calls, and the agent personalities themselves. Settings are scoped to this workspace.
